_attack: f2, f3 and f4 are buttons wearing role=combobox / data-ui=select / class=Select__control. scan-page.js classifies a dropdown by SHAPE, and scan-engine.mjs opens each one with loc.click({ force: true }), which skips every actionability check. f1 is a genuine dropdown: a fix that stops probing everything is visibly wrong.
_v: `v` IS LOAD-BEARING and was missing from the hand-written version of this file. probeRefusal()'s structural half — 'its name is its own text, so it is a button, not a picker' — reads f.v, so without it only the DESTRUCTIVE_LABEL word list was ever exercised and the half the product comment calls structural was tested by nothing. The real scanner emits v = txt(el.value || el.innerText, 60): the three buttons' own rendered text, and the genuine picker's placeholder.
_keys: COMBOS ARE STAMPED FIRST, so the four comboboxes are f1-f4 and the plain text input is f5 — not the reading order the hand-written version used.
